name: list_open_findings
description: Run the finding-closure POLICY SELFTEST. This does NOT project the open findings of any spec -- despite the name it takes no spec and returns no finding list. It executes finding-closure-selftest.sh, which surfaces the canonical contract for finding-set closure (no cherry-picking, no easy-subset remediation) and validates that the workflow agents enforce one-to-one finding accounting. Use to inspect and verify the active finding-closure policy.
